source_findings.takeaway: Codex CLI is a local terminal coding agent that can inspect repositories, run code, work in Windows PowerShell, use web search, and operate with approval modes and MCP.

source_findings.source: OpenAI Codex with ChatGPT plan docs
source_findings.takeaway: Codex access, client choice, plan controls, plugin controls, and workspace app permissions should be treated as explicit governance surfaces.

source_findings.source: Model Context Protocol security best practices
source_findings.takeaway: MCP-style connector flows should minimize scope, protect sessions, restrict SSRF paths, and avoid confused-deputy routing.
Security logs should be proportionate, structured, protected from exposure, and designed to avoid both underlogging and alarm fog.

source_findings.source: NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory reference architecture
source_findings.takeaway: AI-factory architecture should be treated as an end-to-end system of compute, networking, software, services, management, and scaling surfaces rather than isolated accelerator capacity.

source_findings.source: Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform scale docs
source_findings.takeaway: Managed agent platforms separate deploy, manage, access-control, gateway, monitoring, and scaling concerns that map cleanly onto THOS runner governance.
CLI agent surfaces can combine local tools, MCP servers, web search, web fetch, and command workflows, reinforcing the need for explicit tool and data boundaries.
Codex platform changes repeatedly improve setup, network-access handling, task followups, and visibility, so local runner receipts should preserve version and readiness context.
